newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec private machinery orders fall 12.8% m/m.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec private machinery orders fall 12.8% m/m.

text.p: Japan's private-sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell a seasonally adjusted 12.8 percent in December from the previous month to 1.07 trillion yen, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Monday.
The EPA also said it expected private machinery orders in the same category to fall 8.5 percent in the January-March quarter from the previous quarter.
Private machinery orders rose 12.2 percent in calendar 1996, up for third successive year, the EPA said.
